pet_notes: A duo pet: SpongeBob-inspired yellow square sea-sponge character on the left and Patrick-inspired pink starfish character on the right. They are redrawn as original retro pixel-style mascots, not copied game frames. Keep both characters together in every frame, with matching scale, consistent style, stable feet baseline, stable center, crisp dark blue outline, bright simple colors, and no scenery. Dance sequences must feel playful and coordinated. Failed state must be a separate slumped reaction. Sleeping should end on a still resting pose.
style_notes: Retro handheld pixel art, unified proportions, clean readable silhouettes, limited palette, crisp edges, no direct frame copying. The two characters should stay one left-right duo across all states.
style_contract: Pet-safe sprite: compact full-body mascot, readable in a 192x208 cell, clear silhouette, simple face, stable palette/materials, and crisp edges for chroma-key extraction. Style `pixel`: Pixel-art-adjacent digital mascot with a chunky silhouette, simple dark outline, limited palette, flat cel shading, and visible stepped edges.
